description: An Android phone of Samsung (USB vendor 04e8) in USB tethering: RNDIS (rndis_host) and a DHCP address from the phone, which routes and NATs itself; no AT port, no control channel. A phone, not a modem: its APN, network mode and SIM are set on the phone, and it may stop tethering when its screen locks or the cable is replugged. Router mode is its only mode: no problem to report. The phone kind from another modem manager 3.5.x release notes (behaviour only); USB vendor IDs from the Linux USB ID list
